description:
**Past simple (all forms)**（一般过去时综合）

**用法**：规则 + 不规则动词。过去具体时间用过去式。

**例句**：
- I went home early.
- Did she call you?
- They didn't watch TV.

**常见错误**：
- 过去式与现在完成时混用
- 否定句/疑问句 did 后没用原形

**辨析**：过去式 vs. 现在完成时：yesterday vs. ever/never/just。

**Past continuous**（过去进行时）

**用法**：was/were + V-ing。描述过去某时正在进行的动作。

**例句**：
- I was reading when she called.
- They were having dinner at 8 p.m.
- It was raining all night.

**常见错误**：
- was/were 后加原形（*was rain*）
- 漏掉 was/were

**辨析**：过去进行时 vs. 一般过去时：背景动作 vs. 打断动作。

**Present perfect (experiences)**（现在完成时（经历））

**用法**：have/has + 过去分词。表过去经历与现在有关。

**例句**：
- I have visited Paris.
- Have you ever been to Japan?
- She has never eaten sushi.

**常见错误**：
- 与过去时间连用（*I have visited yesterday*）
- have 后加过去式而非过去分词

**辨析**：现在完成时 vs. 一般过去时：无具体过去时间 vs. 有具体过去时间。

**Present perfect with just/already/yet**（just/already/yet）

**用法**：just（刚刚）, already（已经）, yet（还）常与现在完成时连用。

**例句**：
- I've just finished.
- She has already left.
- Have you eaten yet?

**常见错误**：
- yet 用于肯定句
- already 用于疑问句时位置错

**注意**：already 用于肯定/疑问，yet 用于否定/疑问句末。

**For / since**（for / since）

**用法**：for + 一段时间；since + 时间点。常搭配现在完成时。

**例句**：
- I have lived here for ten years.
- She has worked here since 2020.
- We haven't eaten for hours.

**常见错误**：
- for 后接时间点
- since 后接一段时间

**注意**：for 是 duration，since 是 starting point。

**Been / gone**（been / gone）

**用法**：have been to 表示去过（已回）；have gone to 表示去了（未回）。

**例句**：
- He has been to Paris. (回来了)
- He has gone to Paris. (还在那儿)
- I've been there twice.

**常见错误**：
- been 与 gone 混用
- been to 漏 to

**注意**：been 表经历，gone 表不在此地。

grammar: Future: will / going to / present continuous
description:
**Future: will / going to / present continuous**（将来时比较）

**用法**：will 表临时决定/承诺；be going to 表计划/迹象；现在进行时表已安排。

**例句**：
- I'll get it. (临时)
- I'm going to buy a car. (计划)
- I'm meeting her at 6. (已安排)

**常见错误**：
- will 与 be going to 完全等同
- 现在进行时表未来时漏时间状语

**注意**：will 临时，be going to 计划/迹象，现在进行已安排。

**Future time clauses**（将来时间状语从句）

**用法**：时间状语从句中用一般现在时表将来。

**例句**：
- When I arrive, I'll call you.
- I'll tell him as soon as I see him.
- After she finishes, we'll go.

**常见错误**：
- 时间状语从句中用 will（*When I will arrive*）
- 主句用一般现在时表将来

**注意**：主将从现：主句将来，从句现在。

**Modal verbs: can/could/may/might**（情态动词（可能性/许可））

**用法**：can/could 能力/请求；may/might 许可/可能（might 更不确定）。

**例句**：
- You may leave now.
- It might rain tomorrow.
- Could you help me?

**常见错误**：
- 情态动词后加 to 或 -s
- may/might 语气不分

**注意**：might 比 may 可能性更小。

grammar: Must / have to / should / need to
description:
**Must / have to / should / need to**（情态动词（义务））

**用法**：must 强烈/主观；have to 客观；should 建议；need to 需要。

**例句**：
- You must wear a helmet.
- I have to leave now.
- You should apologize.

**常见错误**：
- must 与 have to 完全等同
- should 后加 to

**辨析**：mustn't（禁止） vs. don't have to（不必）。

**Reflexive pronouns**（反身代词）

**用法**：myself, yourself, himself, herself, itself, ourselves, yourselves, themselves。

**例句**：
- I did it myself.
- She taught herself Spanish.
- We enjoyed ourselves.

**常见错误**：
- 主语与反身代词不一致（*He did it myself*）
- enjoy 后漏反身代词

**注意**：enjoy yourself, by yourself, teach yourself。

**Something / anything / nothing / everything**（不定代词）

**用法**：some- 用于肯定；any- 用于否定/疑问；no- 本身否定；every- 表单数。

**例句**：
- I have something to tell you.
- Did you see anything?
- Nothing is impossible.

**常见错误**：
- anything 用于肯定句（需特定语境）
- everyone 后接复数动词

**注意**：everyone/everything + 单数动词。

**Somebody / anybody / nobody / everybody**（不定代词（人））

**用法**：somebody 某人，anybody 任何人，nobody 没人，everybody 每人。

**例句**：
- Somebody is at the door.
- I didn't see anybody.
- Everybody knows that.

**常见错误**：
- everybody 后接复数动词
- nobody 与 not anybody 混淆

**注意**：nobody = not anybody；everybody 接单数动词。

**Adverbs of manner**（方式副词）

**用法**：形容词 + -ly → 副词。well, fast, hard 例外。

**例句**：
- She sings beautifully.
- He runs fast.
- They worked hard.

**常见错误**：
- good 与 well 混用
- 形容词当副词用（*He runs quick*）

**注意**：good 形容词，well 副词；hard 形容词/副词同形。

**Comparative and superlative adverbs**（副词比较级和最高级）

**用法**：more/most + 副词，部分副词有 -er/-est。

**例句**：
- He runs faster than me.
- She speaks more fluently.
- Who works the hardest?

**常见错误**：
- 副词比较级加 more 又加 -er
- 最高级前漏 the

**注意**：fast→faster→fastest；fluently→more fluently→most fluently。

**So / such**（so / such）

**用法**：so + 形容词/副词；such + a/an + 形容词 + 名词。

**例句**：
- It's so hot.
- She is such a kind person.
- The movie was so boring.

**常见错误**：
- such 后漏 a/an
- so + 名词（*so nice weather*，应为 such nice weather）

**注意**：so + adj/adv；such + a/an + adj + noun。

**Very / too / enough**（very / too / enough）

**用法**：very 表程度；too 表过度（负面）；enough 表足够（形容词/副词后）。

**例句**：
- It's very cold.
- It's too expensive for me.
- He isn't old enough to drive.

**常见错误**：
- enough 放在形容词前
- very 与 too 语气不分

**注意**：too...to 结构表太……而不能。

**Adjective + preposition**（形容词 + 介词）

**用法**：be good at, be interested in, be afraid of, be worried about。

**例句**：
- She is good at math.
- I'm interested in music.
- He's afraid of dogs.

**常见错误**：
- 介词搭配错误（*good in*）
- be 动词后接动词原形

**注意**：形容词后的介词多为固定搭配，需记忆。

**Verb + preposition**（动词 + 介词）

**用法**：look for, listen to, wait for, talk about, ask for。

**例句**：
- I'm looking for my keys.
- Listen to me.
- She asked for help.

**常见错误**：
- 介词漏掉（*look my keys*）
- 介词搭配错误

**注意**：动词短语中介词常改变意义。

**Phrasal verbs (separable)**（可分短语动词）

**用法**：put on, take off, turn on, turn off。名词可放中间或后面，代词必须放中间。

**例句**：
- Put on your jacket. / Put your jacket on.
- Turn it off. (不能 turn off it)
- Take off your shoes.

**常见错误**：
- 代词放短语动词后（*turn off it*）
- 名词位置死板

**注意**：代词必须放中间：turn it on, pick it up。

**Phrasal verbs (inseparable)**（不可分短语动词）

**用法**：look after, run out of, look forward to。宾语不能放中间。

**例句**：
- Look after your sister.
- We ran out of milk.
- I look forward to meeting you.

**常见错误**：
- 宾语放中间（*look your sister after*）
- look forward to 后接动词原形

**注意**：look forward to + doing/noun。

**Questions tags**（反义疑问句）

**用法**：前肯定后否定，前否定后肯定。动词与主句一致。

**例句**：
- You're coming, aren't you?
- He likes coffee, doesn't he?
- She didn't go, did she?

**常见错误**：
- 反义疑问句助动词与主句不一致
- 前否定后也用否定

**注意**：Let's... 用 shall we?；I'm... 用 aren't I?。

**Indirect questions**（间接疑问句）

**用法**：Could you tell me + 陈述语序？Do you know + if/whether？

**例句**：
- Could you tell me where the station is?
- Do you know if he is coming?
- I wonder what happened.

**常见错误**：
- 间接疑问句仍用疑问语序（*where is the station*）
- if 与 whether 用法完全等同

**注意**：间接疑问句用陈述语序。

**Used to**（used to 过去习惯）

**用法**：used to + 动词原形，表过去习惯或状态（现在已不同）。

**例句**：
- I used to play football.
- She used to be shy.
- Did you use to live here?

**常见错误**：
- used to 后加 -ing
- used to 与 be used to 混淆

**辨析**：used to（过去习惯） vs. be used to（习惯于）+ doing。

grammar: Be used to / get used to
description:
**Be used to / get used to**（习惯于）

**用法**：be used to + doing/noun 表习惯；get used to 表逐渐习惯。

**例句**：
- I'm used to getting up early.
- You'll get used to the noise.
- She isn't used to spicy food.

**常见错误**：
- be used to 后接动词原形
- get used to 与 used to 混用

**注意**：used to + do（过去）；be used to + doing（习惯）。

**Would (past habits)**（would 过去习惯）

**用法**：would + 动词原形，表过去反复动作。

**例句**：
- When I was young, I would play outside.
- He would always bring flowers.
- We would often go to the beach.

**常见错误**：
- would 后加过去式
- would 与 used to 完全等同

**注意**：would 只表动作习惯，used to 可表状态。

**First conditional**（第一条件句）

**用法**：If + 一般现在时，will + 动词。表真实可能。

**例句**：
- If it rains, I'll stay home.
- If you study, you'll pass.
- I'll call you if I arrive late.

**常见错误**：
- if 从句用 will（*If it will rain*）
- 主句用一般现在时

**注意**：第一条件句：主将从现。

**Second conditional**（第二条件句）

**用法**：If + 过去式，would + 动词。表虚拟/不太可能。

**例句**：
- If I had money, I would buy a car.
- If she knew, she would tell us.
- If I were you, I'd apologize.

**常见错误**：
- if 从句用 would
- I were you 写成 I was you（非正式可接受）

**注意**：第二条件句：与现在事实相反或不太可能。

**Wish / If only**（wish / if only）

**用法**：wish + 过去式（现在）；wish + had + 过去分词（过去）。

**例句**：
- I wish I knew the answer.
- If only I had studied harder.
- I wish it would stop raining.

**常见错误**：
- wish 后接动词原形
- wish 与 hope 混用

**注意**：wish 表遗憾；hope 表真实希望。

**Relative clauses (who/which/that)**（定语从句）

**用法**：who 指人，which 指物，that 可指人或物。

**例句**：
- The man who lives here is my uncle.
- This is the book which I bought.
- I know a place that sells good coffee.

**常见错误**：
- which 指人
- that 后谓语单复数错误

**注意**：限制性定语从句不用逗号隔开。

**Relative clauses with prepositions**（介词 + 关系代词）

**用法**：介词可放从句末尾或 whom/which 前（正式）。

**例句**：
- The man who I spoke to is here.
- The house in which I lived is old. (正式)
- This is the book I told you about.

**常见错误**：
- 介词前置时用 who/that（应为 whom/which）
- 介词后接 that

**注意**：口语中介词常放句末；正式文体放 whom/which 前。

**Defining vs. non-defining relative clauses**（限定 vs. 非限定定语从句）

**用法**：非限定从句用逗号隔开，提供额外信息，不可用 that。

**例句**：
- My brother, who lives in London, is a doctor. (非限定)
- The car that is parked outside is mine. (限定)
- Paris, which is the capital of France, is beautiful.

**常见错误**：
- 非限定从句用 that
- 限定从句逗号错误

**注意**：非限定从句中 who/which 不能省略。

**Gerunds**（动名词）

**用法**：动词 + -ing 作名词用。作主语、宾语、介词宾语。

**例句**：
- Swimming is good for you.
- I enjoy reading.
- She is interested in learning.

**常见错误**：
- enjoy 后接 to do
- 介词后接动词原形

**辨析**：动名词 vs. 不定式：动名词偏习惯/抽象，不定式偏目的/具体。

**Infinitives of purpose**（不定式表目的）

**用法**：to + 动词原形，表目的。

**例句**：
- I went to the shop to buy milk.
- She studied hard to pass the exam.
- He came here to see you.

**常见错误**：
- 表目的用 for + 动词原形（*for buy*）
- to 后接 -ing

**注意**：in order to / so as to 更正式。

**Verb + gerund or infinitive**（动词 + 动名词/不定式）

**用法**：有些动词后接 doing（enjoy, finish），有些接 to do（want, decide），有些两者皆可。

**例句**：
- I want to leave. (to do)
- I enjoy swimming. (doing)
- I stopped smoking. (doing) / I stopped to smoke. (to do)

**常见错误**：
- stop 后接 to do 与 doing 意义混淆
- want 后接 doing

**辨析**：stop doing（停止做） vs. stop to do（停下来去做）。

**Passive voice (present simple)**（一般现在时被动语态）

**用法**：am/is/are + 过去分词。主语是动作承受者。

**例句**：
- The report is written every week.
- Coffee is grown in Brazil.
- The window is cleaned by him.

**常见错误**：
- 被动语态漏掉 be 动词
- 过去分词用成过去式

**辨析**：被动语态 vs. 主动语态：主语是动作承受者。

**Passive voice (past simple)**（一般过去时被动语态）

**用法**：was/were + 过去分词。

**例句**：
- The car was repaired yesterday.
- The letter was sent this morning.
- They were invited to the party.

**常见错误**：
- by 后接主语（应为宾语）
- was/were 与 did 混用

**注意**：by + 动作执行者（可省略）。

**Passive voice with modal verbs**（情态动词被动语态）

**用法**：modal + be + 过去分词。

**例句**：
- It can be done.
- The work must be finished today.
- This should be changed.

**常见错误**：
- 情态动词后接过去分词（*can done*）
- 漏掉 be 动词

**注意**：modal + be + done。

**Causative: have/get something done**（have/get something done）

**用法**：have/get + 宾语 + 过去分词，表让别人做某事。

**例句**：
- I had my hair cut.
- We need to get the car repaired.
- She got the house painted.

**常见错误**：
- have/get 后接动词原形
- 宾语后接现在分词

**注意**：have sth done 与 get sth done 同义。

**Reported speech (statements)**（间接引语（陈述句））

**用法**：主句过去时，从句动词通常后退：现在→过去，过去→过去完成。

**例句**：
- 'I am tired,' he said. → He said (that) he was tired.
- 'I saw her,' she said. → She said (that) she had seen her.
- 'I will call,' he said. → He said (that) he would call.

**常见错误**：
- 间接引语仍用直接引语动词形式
- that 不能省略（口语可省）

**注意**：say → said；tell + 宾语。

**Reported speech (questions)**（间接引语（疑问句））

**用法**：疑问句变陈述语序，用 if/whether 或疑问词引导。

**例句**：
- 'Are you coming?' she asked. → She asked if I was coming.
- 'Where is he?' he asked. → He asked where he was.
- 'Do you like it?' she asked. → She asked whether I liked it.

**常见错误**：
- 间接疑问句仍用疑问语序
- 助动词 do 仍保留

**注意**：asked + if/whether + 陈述语序。

**Reported speech (commands/requests)**（间接引语（命令/请求））

**用法**：tell/ask/order + 宾语 + to do/not to do。

**例句**：
- 'Close the door,' he said. → He told me to close the door.
- 'Please help me,' she said. → She asked me to help her.
- 'Don't be late,' he said. → He told us not to be late.

**常见错误**：
- 间接引语保留 please
- tell 后接 that + 从句表命令

**注意**：tell sb to do；ask sb to do；order sb to do。

**So / because**（so / because）

**用法**：because 表原因；so 表结果。

**例句**：
- I was tired because I worked hard.
- I worked hard, so I was tired.
- Because it rained, we stayed home.

**常见错误**：
- because 与 so 同时用
- because 后接句子，because of 后接名词/动名词

**注意**：because + 句子；because of + noun/gerund。

**Although / though / even though**（although / though / even though）

**用法**：表让步，注意不与 but 连用。

**例句**：
- Although it rained, we went out.
- Though he is young, he is wise.
- Even though she was tired, she worked.

**常见错误**：
- although 与 but 同时用
- though 用于句末时含义不同

**注意**：although/though 不能与 but 同句；however 可。

**However / nevertheless**（however / nevertheless）

**用法**：表转折，常放句首或句中，用逗号隔开。

**例句**：
- It was raining. However, we went out.
- He was tired. Nevertheless, he finished.

**常见错误**：
- however 与 but 同句
- however 后无逗号

**注意**：however 是副词，but 是连词。

**In case**（in case）

**用法**：in case + 句子，表以防万一。

**例句**：
- Take an umbrella in case it rains.
- I'll call you in case I need help.
- In case you forget, here is the key.

**常见错误**：
- in case 与 if 混用
- in case 后接 will

**注意**：in case 引导的从句用一般现在时表将来。

**Unless**（unless）

**用法**：unless = if not。除非。

**例句**：
- I won't go unless you come too.
- Unless you study, you won't pass.
- I'll be surprised unless he wins.

**常见错误**：
- unless 与 if 双重否定
- unless 后接 will

**注意**：unless 从句用一般现在时表将来。

**As soon as / when / until**（时间连词）

**用法**：as soon as/when/until + 一般现在时表将来。

**例句**：
- Call me when you arrive.
- I'll wait until you come back.
- As soon as I finish, I'll call.

**常见错误**：
- 时间从句用 will
- until 与 by 混用

**注意**：until 表动作持续到某时；by 表截止时间。

**By the time**（by the time）

**用法**：by the time + 现在完成时/过去完成时，表到某时为止。

**例句**：
- By the time you arrive, I'll have finished.
- By the time he arrived, we had left.
- By the time she calls, I'll be ready.

**常见错误**：
- by the time 从句用将来时
- 主句时态错误

**注意**：by the time 从句用现在时/过去时，主句用完成时。

grammar: Quantity: a few / few / a little / little
description:
**Quantity: a few / few / a little / little**（a few / few / a little / little）

**用法**：a few/few + 可数；a little/little + 不可数。a few/a little 表肯定，few/little 表否定。

**例句**：
- I have a few friends. (有几个)
- I have few friends. (几乎没有)
- There's a little milk left. (还有一点)

**常见错误**：
- few 与 a few 语气不分
- little 与 a little 混用

**注意**：a few/a little = 一些；few/little = 几乎没有。

**All / none / both / neither / either**（all / none / both / neither / either）

**用法**：all 全部，none 全无，both 两者都，neither 两者都不，either 两者任一。

**例句**：
- All of us are here.
- Neither answer is correct.
- Either day is fine.

**常见错误**：
- neither 与 both 混用
- either 后接单数还是复数动词

**注意**：neither/either + 单数动词；both + 复数动词。

**Each / every**（each / every）

**用法**：each 强调个体，可接 of；every 强调整体，不接 of。

**例句**：
- Each student has a book.
- Every student has a book.
- Each of the students has a book.

**常见错误**：
- every 接 of
- each 与 every 后接单数动词混淆

**注意**：each/every + 单数动词。

**Other / another / others / the others**（other / another / others）

**用法**：another + 单数；other + 复数；others 泛指其他人；the others 特定范围内其余。

**例句**：
- I need another cup.
- Other people may agree.
- Some students left, the others stayed.

**常见错误**：
- another 后接复数
- other 后接单数

**注意**：another one = 再一个；other = 其他的。

**One / ones**（one / ones）

**用法**：one 代替前文提到的单数可数名词，ones 代替复数。

**例句**：
- I prefer the red one.
- Your shoes are nicer than mine, but mine are cheaper ones.
- I want a big one.

**常见错误**：
- one 代替不可数名词
- ones 代替单数名词

**注意**：one/ones 用于避免重复名词。

grammar: So do I / Neither do I
description:
**So do I / Neither do I**（so do I / neither do I）

**用法**：so + 助动词 + 主语，表示也一样；neither + 助动词 + 主语，表示也不。

**例句**：
- I like coffee. So do I.
- I don't like tea. Neither do I.
- He can swim. So can she.

**常见错误**：
- 用 So do I 回应否定句
- 助动词与上句不一致

**注意**：so/neither 后接助动词/be/情态动词，再接主语。

**Linking words: addition**（连接词（递进））

**用法**：also, too, as well, besides, in addition, moreover, furthermore。

**例句**：
- I like coffee. I also like tea.
- She is smart. Moreover, she works hard.
- Besides, it's too expensive.

**常见错误**：
- also 位置错误（句末）
- too 与 also 位置混淆

**注意**：also 在句中，too/as well 在句末。

**Linking words: contrast**（连接词（对比））

**用法**：however, on the other hand, in contrast, whereas, while。

**例句**：
- He is rich, whereas she is poor.
- On the other hand, it might rain.
- In contrast, the second option is cheaper.

**常见错误**：
- whereas 与 however 完全等同
- while 表时间 vs. 对比混淆

**注意**：while/whereas 可直接连接两个分句。

**Linking words: result**（连接词（结果））

**用法**：so, therefore, as a result, consequently, thus。

**例句**：
- It rained. Therefore, the match was cancelled.
- She was ill. As a result, she stayed home.
- He studied hard, so he passed.

**常见错误**：
- therefore 与 because 混用
- so 与 therefore 同句冗余

**注意**：therefore 是副词，常放句首或句中。

**Linking words: giving examples**（连接词（举例））

**用法**：for example, for instance, such as, like, e.g.

**例句**：
- I like fruit, such as apples and oranges.
- For example, he always arrives early.
- Some countries, like Japan, have high-speed trains.

**常见错误**：
- such as 与 for example 后都接完整句子
- like 与 as 混用

**注意**：such as 列举同类事物；for example 可接句子。

**Countable and uncountable review**（可数/不可数复习）

**用法**：复习不可数名词与量词搭配，以及常见错误。

**例句**：
- a piece of advice
- a loaf of bread
- a bar of chocolate

**常见错误**：
- 不可数名词直接加 a/an
- 量词用错（*a glass of bread*）

**注意**：不可数名词需用量词才能计数。

**Expressing opinions**（表达观点）

**用法**：I think (that)..., I believe..., In my opinion..., I agree/disagree。

**例句**：
- I think we should leave early.
- In my opinion, this is the best option.
- I don't agree with you.

**常见错误**：
- In my opinion 与 I think 同句冗余
- I am agree 错误

**注意**：I agree（不是 I am agree）；I think + (that) + 从句。

**Making suggestions**（提出建议）

**用法**：Why don't we...?, How about...?, Let's..., You could..., Maybe we should...

**例句**：
- Why don't we go to the cinema?
- How about having dinner out?
- Maybe we should leave early.

**常见错误**：
- How about 后接 to do（应为 doing）
- Why don't 后接 I/we 主语不一致

**注意**：How about/What about + doing/noun。

**Agreeing and disagreeing**（同意与不同意）

**用法**：I agree, That's right, Exactly, I don't think so, I'm not sure about that。

**例句**：
- I agree with you.
- That's right.
- I'm not sure I agree with that.

**常见错误**：
- I agree 与 I am agree 混淆
- I'm agree 错误

**注意**：agree 是动词，不是形容词。

**Telephone phrases**（电话用语）

**用法**：Can I speak to...?, I'll put you through, Hold on, I'm afraid he's not here.

**例句**：
- Can I speak to John, please?
- I'll put you through.
- Hold on a moment, please.

**常见错误**：
- 电话中说 I want to speak John（漏 to）
- Who is calling? 说成 Who are you?（太直接）

**注意**：This is ... speaking；Who's calling?

**Emails: formal and informal**（邮件正式与非正式）

**用法**：正式邮件用 Dear Sir/Madam, Yours faithfully/sincerely；非正式用 Hi/Hello, Best/Bye。

**例句**：
- Dear Mr. Smith, ... Yours sincerely, ...
- Hi Tom, ... Best, ...
- I am writing to inquire about...

**常见错误**：
- 正式邮件结尾用 Love
- 非正式邮件用 Yours faithfully

**注意**：I look forward to hearing from you.
